name: Pyramids of Giza
description: The oldest and largest of the pyramids in the Giza pyramid complex bordering present-day Giza in Greater Cairo, Egypt.

name: Machu Picchu
description: A 15th-century Inca citadel, located in the Eastern Cordillera of southern Peru on a 2,430-meter mountain ridge.

name: Colosseum
description: An oval amphitheatre in the centre of the city of Rome, Italy, just east of the Roman Forum.

name: Petra
description: A historical and archaeological city in southern Jordan, famous for its rock-cut architecture and water conduit system.

name: Taj Mahal
description: An ivory-white marble mausoleum on the southern bank of the river Yamuna in the Indian city of Agra.

name: Great Wall of China
description: A series of fortifications that were built across the historical northern borders of ancient Chinese states.

name: Chichen Itza
description: A complex of Mayan ruins on Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula. A massive step pyramid, known as El Castillo, dominates the ancient city.

name: Stonehenge
description: A prehistoric monument in Wiltshire, England. It consists of a ring of standing stones, each around 13 feet high.

name: Göbekli Tepe
description: An archaeological site in the Southeastern Anatolia Region of Turkey. The tell has a height of 15 m and is about 300 m in diameter.

name: Ephesus
description: An ancient Greek city on the coast of Ionia, three kilometres southwest of present-day Selçuk in İzmir Province, Turkey.

name: Angkor Wat
description: A temple complex in Cambodia and the largest religious monument in the world by land area, on a site measuring 162.6 hectares.

name: Acropolis of Athens
description: An ancient citadel located on a rocky outcrop above the city of Athens and contains the remains of several ancient buildings of great architectural and historic significance.

name: Hagia Sophia
description: A Late Antique place of worship in Istanbul, designed by the Greek geometers Isidore of Miletus and Anthemius of Tralles.

name: Pompeii
description: An ancient city located in what is now the comune of Pompei near Naples in the Campania region of Italy.

name: Teotihuacan
description: An ancient Mesoamerican city located in a sub-valley of the Valley of Mexico, known for its significant Mesoamerican pyramids.

name: Terracotta Army
description: A collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang, the first Emperor of China.

name: Bagan
description: An ancient city and a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the Mandalay Region of Myanmar.

name: Easter Island (Moai)
description: Famous for its 887 extant monumental statues, called moai, created by the early Rapa Nui people.

name: Alhambra
description: A palace and fortress complex located in Granada, Andalusia, Spain.

name: Cappadocia
description: A historical region in Central Anatolia, largely in the Nevşehir, Kayseri, Kırşehir, Aksaray, and Niğde Provinces in Turkey.

name: Meteora
description: A rock formation in central Greece hosting one of the largest and most precipitously built complexes of Eastern Orthodox monasteries.

name: Mont Saint-Michel
description: A tidal island and mainland commune in Normandy, France.

name: Borobudur
description: A 9th-century Mahayana Buddhist temple in Magelang Regency, not far from the town of Muntilan, in Central Java, Indonesia.

name: Christ the Redeemer
description: An Art Deco statue of Jesus Christ in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

name: Statue of Liberty
description: A colossal neoclassical sculpture on Liberty Island in New York Harbor within New York City.

name: Sydney Opera House
description: A multi-venue performing arts centre at Sydney Harbour in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.

name: Burj Khalifa
description: A skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is the world's tallest building.

name: Mount Fuji
description: An active volcano about 100 kilometers southwest of Tokyo. Commonly called 'Fuji-san'.

name: Grand Canyon
description: A steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States.

name: Niagara Falls
description: A group of three waterfalls at the southern end of Niagara Gorge, spanning the border between the province of Ontario in Canada and the state of New York in the United States.

name: Victoria Falls
description: A waterfall on the Zambezi River in southern Africa, which provides habitat for several unique species of plants and animals.

name: Galapagos Islands
description: An archipelago of volcanic islands in the Pacific Ocean. It is considered one of the world's foremost destinations for wildlife-viewing.

name: Great Barrier Reef
description: The world's largest coral reef system composed of over 2,900 individual reefs and 900 islands stretching for over 2,300 kilometres.

name: Banff National Park
description: Canada's oldest national park, established in 1885. Located in the Rocky Mountains.

name: Yellowstone National Park
description: An American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana and Idaho.

name: Yosemite National Park
description: An American national park located in the western Sierra Nevada of Central California.

name: Santorini
description: An island in the southern Aegean Sea, about 200 km southeast of Greece's mainland.

name: Venice
description: A city in northeastern Italy and the capital of the Veneto region. It is built on a group of 118 small islands.

name: Kyoto
description: Ideally located in the Kansai region, Kyoto is one of Japan’s oldest municipalities.

name: Jerusalem
description: A city in the Middle East, located on a plateau in the Judaean Mountains between the Mediterranean and the Dead Sea.

name: Mecca (Kaaba)
description: The holiest city in Islam, located in the Sirat Mountains in western Saudi Arabia.

name: Vatican City
description: An independent city-state enclaved within Rome, Italy. The Vatican City State, also known simply as the Vatican, became independent from Italy with the Lateran Treaty (1929).

name: Lourdes
description: A town in southwestern France, in the foothills of the Pyrenees mountains.

name: Mount Sinai
description: A mountain in the Sinai Peninsula of Egypt. It is a possible location of the biblical Mount Sinai.

name: Lalibela
description: A town in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia famous for its rock-cut monolithic churches.

name: Timbuktu
description: A city in Mali, situated 20 km north of the Niger River. It is the capital of the Timbuktu Region.

name: Djenné
description: A town and an urban commune in the Inland Niger Delta region of central Mali.

name: Great Zimbabwe
description: A ruined city in the south-eastern hills of Zimbabwe near Lake Mutirikwe and the town of Masvingo.

name: Persepolis
description: The ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire (c. 550–330 BC).

name: Shiraz
description: The fifth-most-populous city of Iran and the capital of Fars Province (Old Persian as Pärsah).

name: Isfahan
description: A major city in the Greater Isfahan Region, Isfahan Province, Iran.

name: Samarkand
description: A city in southeastern Uzbekistan and among the oldest continuously inhabited cities in Central Asia.

name: Bukhara
description: The capital of the Bukhara Region of Uzbekistan.

name: Khiva
description: A district-level city of approximately 90,000 people in Xorazm Region, Uzbekistan.

name: Forbidden City
description: A palace complex in Dongcheng District, Beijing, China, at the center of the Imperial City of Beijing.

name: Summer Palace
description: A vast ensemble of lakes, gardens and palaces in Beijing.

name: Temple of Heaven
description: A complex of religious buildings situated in the southeastern part of central Beijing.

name: Potala Palace
description: A a dzong fortress in the city of Lhasa, in Tibet.

name: Himeji Castle
description: A hilltop Japanese castle complex situated in the city of Himeji which is located in the Hyōgo Prefecture of Japan.

name: Kinkaku-ji
description: Officially named Rokuon-ji, is a Zen Buddhist temple in Kyoto, Japan.

name: Fushimi Inari-taisha
description: The head shrine of the kami Inari, located in Fushimi-ku, Kyoto, Japan.

name: Todai-ji
description: A Buddhist temple complex that was once one of the powerful Seven Great Temples, located in the city of Nara, Japan.

name: Itsukushima Shrine
description: A Shinto shrine on the island of Itsukushima, best known for its 'floating' torii gate.

name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial
description: A memorial park in the center of Hiroshima, Japan. It is dedicated to the legacy of Hiroshima as the first city in the world to suffer a nuclear attack.

name: Seoul (Gyeongbokgung)
description: The main royal palace of the Joseon dynasty. Built in 1395, it is located in northern Seoul, South Korea.

name: Jeju Island
description: Korea's largest island, long known for its sea women (haenyeo), tombs, and mixed religious traditions.

name: Ha Long Bay
description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and popular travel destination in Quang Ninh Province, Vietnam.

name: Hoi An
description: A city on Vietnam's central coast known for its well-preserved Ancient Town, cut through with canals.

name: Ayutthaya
description: A historic city in Thailand, once the capital of the Kingdom of Siam.

name: Sukhothai
description: A small city in northern Thailand, capital of the province of the same name.

name: Wat Arun
description: A Buddhist temple in Bangkok Yai district of Bangkok, Thailand, on the Thonburi west bank of the Chao Phraya River.

name: Boracay
description: A small island in the central Philippines. It's known for its resorts and beaches.

name: Banaue Rice Terraces
description: Carved into the mountains of Ifugao in the Philippines by the ancestors of the indigenous people.

name: Petronas Towers
description: Twin skyscrapers in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. According to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat's official definition and ranking, they were the tallest buildings in the world from 1998 to 2004.

name: Batu Caves
description: A limestone hill that has a series of caves and cave temples in Gombak, Selangor, Malaysia.

name: Gardens by the Bay
description: A nature park spanning 101 hectares in the Central Region of Singapore, adjacent to the Marina Reservoir.

name: Marina Bay Sands
description: A resort fronting Marina Bay in Singapore.

name: Bali (Uluwatu Temple)
description: A Balinese Hindu sea temple (Pura Segara) located in Uluwatu.

name: Komodo National Park
description: A national park in Indonesia located within the Lesser Sunda Islands.

name: Raja Ampat
description: Located off the northwest tip of Bird's Head Peninsula on the island of New Guinea, in Indonesia's Southwest Papua province.

name: Hobbiton Movie Set
description: A significant location used for The Lord of the Rings film trilogy and The Hobbit film trilogy.

name: Milford Sound
description: A fiord in the southwest of New Zealand's South Island.

name: Aoraki / Mount Cook
description: The highest mountain in New Zealand.

name: Fiji (Mamanuca Islands)
description: A volcanic archipelago lying to the west of Nadi and to the south of the Yasawa Islands.

name: Bora Bora
description: An island group in the Leeward Islands. The Leeward Islands comprise the western part of the Society Islands of French Polynesia.
